tools.name: long_run_plan
tools.description: Open a long-horizon autonomous run. Call it at the start of any task you intend to run for hours or days: many steps, background jobs, subagents. Declare the ordered todos and the definition-of-done criteria. An external supervisor then wakes this conversation whenever it goes idle before the run is closed. Only one open run per conversation; close the current one first.

label.description: Short human-readable name for the run (builds the run id, used in supervisor messages).

todos.description: Ordered list of the tasks that make up the run.

dod.description: Definition-of-done: the criteria that must ALL be satisfied for the run to count as complete.

tools.name: long_run_update
tools.description: Update an open run: mark, add, edit or remove todos; satisfy, add, edit or remove DoD criteria. Pass a short reason; every change is recorded in the run's changelog. Requires ownership. Refused while the run is blocked (call long_run_resume first).

run_id.description: The run id returned by long_run_plan.

reason.description: Short reason for the update; recorded in the changelog.

todo_id.description: Target todo id (e.g. t1) for mark_todo/edit_todo/remove_todo.

dod_id.description: Target DoD id (e.g. d1) for set_dod/edit_dod/remove_dod.

note.description: Optional note attached to a todo (mark_todo).

satisfied.description: Whether a DoD criterion is satisfied (set_dod).

evidence.description: Optional evidence for a satisfied DoD criterion (set_dod).

tools.name: long_run_read
tools.description: Read a run's full state (with run_id) or a summary of the runs this conversation owns (without): todos, definition-of-done, status, owner, participants, external waits, and the changelog. Read-only; allowed on a blocked run.

run_id.description: Optional run id. Omit to list the runs owned by this conversation.

tools.name: long_run_list
tools.description: List every long-run on disk, including runs whose owner conversation may be gone, so you can claim and continue one. Shows id, status, owner, age, progress and pending waits.

tools.name: long_run_note
tools.description: Append a note to an open run's changelog without changing its structure. Use it for findings or decisions. Requires ownership. Refused while the run is blocked.

tools.name: long_run_watch
tools.description: Declare an external wait for this run: something you launched that returns immediately (often with a job id) and whose outcome is only visible by polling. Give the supervisor idempotent shell checks (exit 0 = the named event happened; any other exit is ignored; no regex): 'ready_when' fires a success wake, the optional 'failed_when' fires a failure wake, and the timeout fires a neutral wake. If both checks are true in the same poll you get a neutral wake saying so. While the wait is pending the supervisor does NOT nudge this conversation. Use ONLY for external things Vellum cannot track; Vellum background commands do not need it. Requires ownership. Refused while the run is blocked.

label.description: Short label for the wait (used in the wake message and shown in the run).

ready_when.description: Idempotent shell check: exits 0 when the wait is over (success). Any other exit is ignored and the wait continues. Must have no side effects; it is run repeatedly.

failed_when.description: Optional idempotent shell check: exits 0 when the process failed prematurely (error, blocked, terminated). Any other exit is ignored. Must have no side effects; it is run repeatedly.

via.description: Where to run the checks: 'container', 'host' (the Mac host, via assistant host-exec), or 'ssh:<hostname>'.

timeout_minutes.description: Maximum minutes to wait before a neutral timeout wake. Required.

note.description: Optional note about what is being awaited.

tools.name: long_run_watch_clear
tools.description: Cancel an external wait declared with long_run_watch, for example after it fired and you resumed. Requires ownership. Refused while the run is blocked.

watch_id.description: The watch id returned by long_run_watch (e.g. w1).

tools.name: long_run_postpone
tools.description: Blind wait: push the next supervisor wake out by up to 30 minutes per call. Prefer long_run_watch when the thing you are waiting on is observable. Requires ownership. Refused while the run is blocked.

minutes.description: Minutes to postpone the next wake (1-30).

tools.name: long_run_claim
tools.description: Take control of a run owned by another conversation, or an orphaned one. Records the handoff in participants and changelog. Allowed on a blocked run. Use long_run_list to find runs worth resuming.

tools.name: long_run_resume
tools.description: Clear a block and return the run to active. The only exit from blocked. Records the reason. Requires ownership.

reason.description: Why the run can proceed again (e.g. the user unblocked it).

tools.name: long_run_block
tools.description: Declare the run blocked on the user. The supervisor sends one confirmation wake, then stays silent; all mutating tools are refused until the run is resumed. State why you are blocked and what you need. Requires ownership. Allowed on an already-blocked run (updates the reason).

need_from_user.description: What the user must provide or decide to unblock it.

tools.name: long_run_end
tools.description: Close a run as done. Requires every todo terminal and every DoD criterion satisfied; pass force=true to override (recorded with the reason). Allowed on a blocked run. Requires ownership. Stops the supervisor.

summary.description: Short summary of the completed run.

force.description: Close even if not all todos/DoD are satisfied.
